steps.text: The overhead depth places the can at roughly world `(3.00, -1.89, 0.99) m` and the bowl near `(2.64, -1.68, 0.94) m`. I’m setting up a live command loop so I can inspect each step before committing to the next movement.

steps.code:
const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Interactive vision-guided controller for the RoboCasa GR1 service episode.
+
+Reads one JSON command per stdin line. It keeps one Robot client alive so each
+observation and action belongs to the same episode. Commands:
+  {"op":"observe", "depth":true}
+  {"op":"submit", "right":[x,y,z,rx,ry,rz], "left":[...],
+   "rh":[six hand values], "lh":[six hand values], "steps":N}
+Action coordinates are robot-base frame; the simulator runs at 20 Hz.
+"""
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = "/app/output"
+CAMS = ["egoview", "robot0_eye_in_right_hand", "robot0_eye_in_left_hand",
+        "robot0_agentview_left", "robot0_agentview_right"]
+
+robot = Robot()
+spec = robot.spec()
+print("CONNECTED", json.dumps({"protocol": spec.get("protocol"),
+      "control_dt": spec.get("control_dt"), "time_budget": spec.get("budget"),
+      "cameras": list(spec.get("cameras", {}))}), flush=True)
+
+def save_obs(result, label):
+    path = os.path.join(OUT, label)
+    result.save(path)
+    p = result.meta.get("proprio", {})
+    now = np.asarray(p.get("now", []), dtype=float)
+    print("OBS", json.dumps({"label": label, "meta": result.meta,
+          "eef_left_world": now[78:81].tolist() if len(now) >= 81 else None,
+          "eef_right_world": now[81:84].tolist() if len(now) >= 84 else None,
+          "cmd_right": now[84:90].tolist() if len(now) >= 90 else None,
+          "cmd_left": now[90:96].tolist() if len(now) >= 96 else None,
+          "hands": now[96:108].tolist() if len(now) >= 108 else None,
+          "saved": path}), flush=True)
+
+n = 0
+try:
+    save_obs(robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMS, include_depth=True, video="none"), "live_000")
+    for line in sys.stdin:
+        line = line.strip()
+        if not line:
+            continue
+        cmd = json.loads(line)
+        op = cmd.get("op")
+        if op == "observe":
+            n += 1
+            result = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMS, include_depth=cmd.get("depth", True),
+                                   seconds=float(cmd.get("seconds", 0)), video="none")
+            save_obs(result, f"live_{n:03d}")
+        elif op == "submit":
+            # An observation supplies the current absolute targets if omitted.
+            cur = robot.get_obs(cameras=[], include_depth=False, video="none").meta["proprio"]["now"]
+            row = np.zeros(24, dtype=np.float64)
+            row[0:6] = cmd.get("right", cur[84:90])
+            row[6:12] = cmd.get("left", cur[90:96])
+            row[12:18] = cmd.get("rh", cur[96:102])
+            row[18:24] = cmd.get("lh", cur[102:108])
+            steps = int(cmd.get("steps", 1))
+            if steps < 1 or steps > 200:
+                raise ValueError("steps must be between 1 and 200")
+            result = robot.submit("ee_pose", np.repeat(row[None, :], steps, axis=0),
+                                  dt=spec["control_dt"], interpolate="hold",
+                                  cameras=CAMS, video="none", include_depth=True,
+                                  note=str(cmd.get("note", "vision-guided action")))
+            n += 1
+            save_obs(result, f"live_{n:03d}")
+        elif op == "status":
+            print("STATUS", json.dumps(robot.status()), flush=True)
+        elif op == "quit":
+            print("CONTROLLER_EXIT", flush=True)
+            break
+        else:
+            print("ERROR unknown command", flush=True)
+except Exception as exc:
+    print("CONTROLLER_ERROR", repr(exc), flush=True)
+    raise
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
